scales_household_strategies.name: scales_household_strategies
scales_household_strategies.value: ("scales"."scope" = 'domacnost') = ("scales"."merge_strategy" is not null and "scales"."split_strategy" is not null)

effects_exactly_one_owner.name: effects_exactly_one_owner
effects_exactly_one_owner.value: ("effects"."rule_id" is not null) <> ("effects"."answer_option_id" is not null)

character_scale_values_clamp_consistency.name: character_scale_values_clamp_consistency
character_scale_values_clamp_consistency.value: ("character_scale_values"."was_clamped" = false) or ("character_scale_values"."raw_value" is not null and "character_scale_values"."raw_value" <> "character_scale_values"."value")

household_scale_values_clamp_consistency.name: household_scale_values_clamp_consistency
household_scale_values_clamp_consistency.value: ("household_scale_values"."was_clamped" = false) or ("household_scale_values"."raw_value" is not null and "household_scale_values"."raw_value" <> "household_scale_values"."value")

templates_target_matches_kind.name: templates_target_matches_kind
templates_target_matches_kind.value:
case "templates"."kind"
            when 'postava' then "templates"."character_id" is not null and "templates"."group_id" is null
            when 'skupina' then "templates"."group_id" is not null and "templates"."character_id" is null
            else "templates"."character_id" is null and "templates"."group_id" is null
          end
